source.text: לֹֽא־יִ֠הְיֶה לַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם כָּל־שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ יֹאכֵלֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Not shall be to the priests the Levites, all [the] tribe of Levi, portion and inheritance with Israel; [the] fire offerings of Yahweh and his inheritance they shall eat.

en.L: There shall not be for the priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi, a portion or an inheritance with Israel; the offerings by fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and his inheritance they shall eat.
en.B: The Levitical priests, and indeed the whole tribe of Levi, will receive no portion and no inheritance alongside Israel. They will eat from the food offerings of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since these are their inheritance.
en.R: The priests and the whole tribe of Levi will not get a share of the land like the rest of Israel. Instead, they will live on the food offerings burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That is their share.

es.L: No habrá para los sacerdotes, los levitas, toda la tribu de Leví, porción ni herencia con Israel; las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y su herencia comerán.
es.B: Los sacerdotes levitas, y en verdad toda la tribu de Leví, no recibirán porción ni herencia junto con Israel. Comerán de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque esa es su herencia.
es.R: Los sacerdotes y toda la tribu de Leví no recibirán una parte de la tierra como el resto de Israel. En cambio, vivirán de las ofrendas quemadas en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esa es su parte.

fr.L: Il n’y aura pas pour les prêtres, les Lévites, toute la tribu de Lévi, de part ni d’héritage avec Israël ; les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et son héritage, ils [les] mangeront.
fr.B: Les prêtres lévites, et même toute la tribu de Lévi, ne recevront ni part ni héritage avec le reste d’Israël. Ils se nourriront des offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car c’est là leur héritage.
fr.R: Les prêtres et toute la tribu de Lévi ne recevront pas de part du pays comme le reste d’Israël. Ils vivront plutôt des offrandes brûlées sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est cela, leur part.

sw.L: Hakutakuwa kwa makuhani, Walawi, kabila lote la Lawi, fungu wala urithi pamoja na Israeli; sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na urithi wake ndivyo watakavyokula.
sw.B: Makuhani Walawi, naam, kabila lote la Lawi, hawatapata fungu wala urithi pamoja na Israeli. Watakula katika sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana hizo ndizo urithi wao.
sw.R: Makuhani na kabila lote la Lawi hawatapata sehemu ya nchi kama Waisraeli wengine. Badala yake, wataishi kwa sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hilo ndilo fungu lao.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ, là người Lê-vi, toàn thể chi tộc Lê-vi, sẽ không có phần hay sản nghiệp cùng với Y-sơ-ra-ên; họ sẽ ăn các của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sản nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ người Lê-vi, và cả chi tộc Lê-vi nữa, sẽ không nhận phần hay sản nghiệp như các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên khác. Họ sẽ ăn từ các của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì đó là sản nghiệp của họ.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ và cả chi tộc Lê-vi sẽ không được chia phần đất như những người Y-sơ-ra-ên khác. Thay vào đó, họ sẽ sống nhờ các lễ vật người ta thiêu dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Đó là phần của họ.

ko.L: 레위인 제사장들, 곧 레위 지파 전체에게는 이스라엘과 함께 [받는] 몫이나 유산이 없을 것이다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물과 그분의 유산을 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 레위인 제사장들과 레위 지파 전체는 이스라엘의 다른 지파들과 함께 몫이나 유산을 받지 못한다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물을 먹고 살 것이니, 그것이 그들의 유산이다.
ko.R: 제사장들과 레위 지파 사람들은 모두 다른 이스라엘 사람들처럼 땅을 나누어 받지 못합니다. 그 대신 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불에 태워 바친 제물로 먹고 삽니다. 그것이 그들의 몫입니다.

pt.L: Não haverá para os sacerdotes, os levitas, toda a tribo de Levi, porção nem herança com Israel; das ofertas queimadas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e da sua herança comerão.
pt.B: Os sacerdotes levitas, e de fato toda a tribo de Levi, não receberão porção nem herança junto com Israel. Eles comerão das ofertas queimadas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois essa é a herança deles.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes e toda a tribo de Levi não vão receber uma parte da terra como o resto de Israel. Em vez disso, vão viver das ofertas queimadas no fogo {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}. Essa é a parte deles.

decisions.choice: the priests, the Levites, all the tribe of Levi: the priests who come from Levi, and with them the whole tribe
decisions.reason: "The priests, the Levites" names the priests by their tribe, as in 17:9 and 17:18. "All the tribe of Levi" then widens the rule: neither the priests nor the rest of the tribe receive land. Verses 3-5 go on to the priests' share and verses 6-8 to the other Levites.

decisions.choice: portion and inheritance: a share of the land
decisions.reason: When the land was divided, each tribe received its own territory as a lasting family possession. Levi received none, only towns to live in and what was given to the LORD (10:9; 12:12; 14:27, 29; Numbers 18:20-24; 35:1-8).

decisions.choice: the offerings by fire of the LORD: the gifts presented to the LORD at the altar
decisions.reason: The word is linked to the word for fire and names the offerings given to the LORD on the altar. Parts of many of them were not burned but went to the priests as food (Leviticus 2:3, 10; 6:10-11; Numbers 18:8-19). These gifts are how the priests are to live.

decisions.choice: his inheritance: the inheritance of Levi, that is, what is given to the LORD
alternatives: his inheritance: what belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: "His" most likely means Levi, the tribe spoken of as one person, as in verse 2 ("the LORD is his inheritance"): the LORD's offerings are what Levi inherits in place of land. It can also be read as the LORD's own inheritance, what belongs to him, which he then shares with the priests. Either way the Levites live on what is given to the LORD.

decisions.choice: the Levitical priests; food offerings
decisions.reason: Balanced says "the Levitical priests" for "the priests, the Levites", as in 17:9; Balanced adds "indeed" to show that the second phrase widens the first. Readable says "the priests" and names the tribe. "Food offerings" is the wording settled in Leviticus for these gifts; Literal keeps "offerings by fire".

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng bằng lửa" for the fire offerings
decisions.reason: The term sheet's phrase for ʾishsheh, as in Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "sản nghiệp" for the inheritance (L, B); "phần đất", "phần" (R)
decisions.reason: A share of the land handed down in a family (meaning decision); "sản nghiệp" is the word Genesis and Joshua use.

decisions.choice: "불로 바치는 제물" (Literal, Balanced), "불에 태워 바친 제물" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's rendering of the food offering, as Leviticus in this translation.

decisions.choice: as ofertas queimadas (L, B); as ofertas queimadas no fogo (R)
decisions.reason: The term of docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md for this offering (m3), "a oferta queimada", with Readable's "queimadas no fogo" as Leviticus 23:36 has it. "Os sacerdotes, os levitas" (L), "os sacerdotes levitas" (B) as set at 17:9.

source.text: וְנַחֲלָ֥ה לֹא־יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And inheritance not shall be to him in [the] midst of his brothers; Yahweh, he [is] his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

en.L: And he shall have no inheritance in the midst of his brothers; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is his inheritance, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to him.
en.B: Among the other tribes Levi will own nothing as an inheritance; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is his inheritance, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told him.
en.R: The tribe of Levi will have no land among the other tribes. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} is their share, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised them.

es.L: Y no tendrá herencia en medio de sus hermanos; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es su herencia, como le habló.
es.B: Leví no poseerá nada como herencia entre las demás tribus; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es su herencia, como se lo dijo.
es.R: La tribu de Leví no tendrá tierra entre las otras tribus. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo es su parte, tal como se lo prometió.

fr.L: Et il n’aura pas d’héritage au milieu de ses frères ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} son héritage, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lui a dit.
fr.B: Lévi ne possédera aucun héritage parmi les autres tribus ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est son héritage, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lui a dit.
fr.R: La tribu de Lévi n’aura pas de terre parmi les autres tribus. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui est leur part, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le leur a promis.

sw.L: Wala hatakuwa na urithi katikati ya ndugu zake; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye urithi wake, kama alivyomwambia.
sw.B: Lawi hatamiliki kitu chochote kama urithi miongoni mwa makabila mengine; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye urithi wake, kama alivyomwambia.
sw.R: Kabila la Lawi halitakuwa na ardhi miongoni mwa makabila mengine. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ndiye fungu lao, kama alivyowaahidi.

vi.L: Và người ấy sẽ không có sản nghiệp ở giữa anh em mình; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là sản nghiệp của người ấy, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với người ấy.
vi.B: Lê-vi sẽ không có sản nghiệp giữa các chi tộc anh em; chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là sản nghiệp của Lê-vi, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với họ.
vi.R: Chi tộc Lê-vi sẽ không có đất đai giữa các chi tộc khác. Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là phần của họ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그에게는 그의 형제들 가운데서 유산이 없을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분이 그의 유산이시다.
ko.B: 레위는 다른 지파들 가운데서 유산으로 받을 것이 없다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그의 유산이시다.
ko.R: 레위 지파는 다른 지파들 가운데서 땅을 받지 못합니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그들의 몫이 되어 주십니다.

pt.L: E herança não terá ele no meio dos seus irmãos; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] a sua herança, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe falou.
pt.B: Levi não terá herança entre as outras tribos; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é a sua herança, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe disse.
pt.R: A tribo de Levi não vai ter terra entre as outras tribos. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}} é a parte deles, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu.

decisions.choice: him; his brothers: the tribe of Levi, and the other tribes of Israel
decisions.reason: As in verse 1 and 10:9, the tribe is spoken of as one man, Levi. "His brothers" are the other tribes, all descended from the sons of Jacob.

decisions.choice: the LORD, he is his inheritance: Levi's portion is the LORD himself
decisions.reason: The pronoun "he" is written out for emphasis. In place of fields and pasture, Levi has the LORD, his service and what is given to him. Psalms 16:5 and 73:26 use the same picture for the believer who has God as his portion.

decisions.choice: as he spoke to him: the LORD's word to Aaron in Numbers 18:20
decisions.reason: In Numbers 18:20 the LORD tells Aaron, "I am your portion and your inheritance among the sons of Israel." Deuteronomy 10:9 refers to the same promise.

decisions.choice: Levi; the other tribes; the tribe of Levi ... their
decisions.reason: Balanced names Levi and says "the other tribes" for "his brothers". Readable says "the tribe of Levi" and uses "their", as in 10:9, so that no one thinks of a single man; it says "promised", the sense of "spoke" here.

source.text: וְזֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֗ם מֵאֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַזֶּ֖בַח אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֑ה וְנָתַן֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַזְּרֹ֥עַ וְהַלְּחָיַ֖יִם וְהַקֵּבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And this shall be [the] due of the priests from the people, from those sacrificing the sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: and he shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.

en.L: And this shall be the priests' due from the people, from those who sacrifice a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: he shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach.
en.B: This is what the priests are owed by the people who offer a sacrifice, whether an ox or a sheep: they are to give the priest the shoulder, the jaws and the stomach.
en.R: When people offer a sacrifice of a bull or cow, or of a sheep or goat, they must give the priest his share. He gets the shoulder, the cheeks and the stomach.

es.L: Y este será el derecho de los sacerdotes de parte del pueblo, de parte de los que ofrecen un sacrificio, sea buey o sea oveja: dará al sacerdote la espaldilla, las dos mejillas y el estómago.
es.B: Esto es lo que los sacerdotes tienen derecho a recibir del pueblo, de los que ofrecen un sacrificio, sea buey u oveja: darán al sacerdote la espaldilla, las quijadas y el estómago.
es.R: Cuando alguien ofrezca en sacrificio un toro o una vaca, o una oveja o una cabra, tiene que darle al sacerdote su parte. Al sacerdote le tocan la espaldilla, las mejillas y el estómago.

fr.L: Et voici ce que sera le dû des prêtres de la part du peuple, de la part de ceux qui offrent un sacrifice, que ce soit un bœuf ou un mouton : il donnera au prêtre l’épaule, les deux joues et l’estomac.
fr.B: Voici ce que les prêtres sont en droit de recevoir du peuple, de ceux qui offrent un sacrifice, bœuf ou mouton : ils donneront au prêtre l’épaule, les mâchoires et l’estomac.
fr.R: Quand des gens offrent en sacrifice un taureau ou une vache, un mouton ou une chèvre, ils doivent donner au prêtre sa part. Il reçoit l’épaule, les joues et l’estomac.

sw.L: Na hii ndiyo itakayokuwa stahili ya makuhani kutoka kwa watu, kutoka kwa wale wanaotoa dhabihu, ikiwa ni ng'ombe au kondoo: atampa kuhani bega, na mashavu mawili, na tumbo.
sw.B: Hiki ndicho makuhani wanachostahili kupokea kutoka kwa watu wanaotoa dhabihu, iwe ng'ombe au kondoo: watampa kuhani bega, taya na tumbo.
sw.R: Watu wanapotoa dhabihu ya fahali au ng'ombe jike, au ya kondoo au mbuzi, lazima wampe kuhani fungu lake. Yeye anapata bega, mashavu na tumbo.

vi.L: Và đây sẽ là phần thuộc về các thầy tế lễ từ dân chúng, từ những người dâng sinh tế, dù là bò hay chiên: người ấy phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ cái vai, hai cái má và cái dạ dày.
vi.B: Đây là phần dân chúng phải trả cho các thầy tế lễ khi dâng sinh tế, dù là bò hay chiên: họ phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ cái vai, hai má và cái dạ dày.
vi.R: Khi người ta dâng một con bò, một con chiên hay một con dê làm sinh tế, họ phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ phần của ông. Thầy tế lễ được cái vai, hai má và cái dạ dày.

ko.L: 그리고 백성에게서, 곧 제물을 잡아 바치는 자들에게서 제사장들이 받을 몫은 이러하다. 소든 양이든 [바치는 사람은] 앞다리와 두 볼과 위를 제사장에게 주어야 한다.
ko.B: 백성이 소나 양을 잡아 제물로 바칠 때 제사장들이 받을 몫은 이러하다. 그들은 앞다리와 턱과 위를 제사장에게 주어야 한다.
ko.R: 사람들이 소나 양이나 염소를 제물로 잡아 바칠 때에는 제사장에게 그의 몫을 주어야 합니다. 제사장은 앞다리와 볼살과 위를 받습니다.

pt.L: E este será o direito dos sacerdotes da parte do povo, da parte dos que sacrificam um sacrifício, seja boi, seja ovelha: ele dará ao sacerdote a espádua, e as duas queixadas, e o estômago.
pt.B: Isto é o que os sacerdotes têm o direito de receber do povo que oferece um sacrifício, seja um boi, seja uma ovelha: dará ao sacerdote a espádua, as queixadas e o estômago.
pt.R: Quando as pessoas oferecerem um sacrifício de um boi ou de uma vaca, ou de uma ovelha ou de uma cabra, devem dar ao sacerdote a parte dele. Ele recebe a paleta, as bochechas e o estômago.

decisions.choice: the due of the priests: the share that is theirs by right
decisions.reason: The word usually means judgment or ruling, but here it is what is rightly owed, the priests' fixed claim. In 1 Samuel 2:13 the same word describes the priests' practice at Shiloh, where Eli's sons took more than was theirs.

decisions.choice: those who sacrifice a sacrifice: worshipers who slaughter an animal for a shared meal
decisions.reason: This kind of sacrifice was eaten by the worshipers at the chosen place, with a part for the altar and a part for the priest (12:6-7, 27). The list of parts here is not the same as the breast and right thigh given to the priests in Leviticus 7:31-34; the text does not say how the two lists relate.

decisions.choice: ox or sheep: an animal from the herd or the flock
decisions.reason: The first word is any head of cattle, bull or cow. The second is a single animal of the flock, sheep or goat (14:4).

decisions.choice: the shoulder, the two cheeks, the stomach: the foreleg, the jaws with their meat, and the stomach
decisions.reason: The first word is the arm, here the upper foreleg of the animal. The second is the jawbones and cheeks. The third is the stomach, the part that digests the food. All three were parts that could be eaten.

decisions.choice: he shall give: each worshiper gives
decisions.reason: The verb is singular: each person who brings the sacrifice gives the priest these parts.

decisions.choice: an ox or a sheep; a bull or cow, a sheep or goat; the jaws / the cheeks
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "ox" and "sheep". Readable names both kinds each word can mean. Balanced says "jaws" and Readable "cheeks" for the jawbones with their meat; Literal keeps "the two cheeks". Balanced says "they" for the singular "he", since every worshiper is meant.

decisions.choice: "stahili ya makuhani" (L); "wanachostahili kupokea" (B)
decisions.reason: The word here is what the priests are rightly owed. Swahili says this with "stahili" (what one is entitled to), and keeps "haki" for righteousness and justice.

decisions.choice: "앞다리", "두 볼" (Literal) / "턱" (Balanced) / "볼살" (Readable), "위"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the "arm" as the foreleg; the Balanced follows the English "jaws", the Readable says the meat of the cheeks.

decisions.choice: a espádua, as (duas) queixadas, o estômago (L, B); a paleta, as bochechas, o estômago (R)
decisions.reason: The parts of the animal (m4) take the words of the butcher's and the cook's Portuguese: "espádua" for the foreleg and shoulder, "queixadas" for the jaws with their meat; Readable says "paleta", the cut Brazilian readers know, and "bochechas", as the English Readable says "cheeks".

source.text: רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ וְרֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְךָ֖ תִּתֶּן־לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] first of your grain, your new wine and your fresh oil, and [the] first of [the] fleece of your flock you shall give to him.

en.L: The first of your grain, your new wine and your fresh oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock you shall give to him.
en.B: Give him as well the first of your grain, of your new wine and of your olive oil, and the first wool your sheep yield at shearing.
en.R: Also give the priest the first part of your grain, your new wine and your olive oil. And give him the first wool you cut from your sheep.

es.L: Las primicias de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite fresco, y las primicias del esquileo de tu rebaño, se las darás.
es.B: Dale también las primicias de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite de oliva, y la primera lana que den tus ovejas al esquilarlas.
es.R: Dale también al sacerdote la primera parte de tu grano, de tu vino nuevo y de tu aceite de oliva. Y dale la primera lana que cortes de tus ovejas.

fr.L: Les prémices de ton blé, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile fraîche, et les prémices de la tonte de ton petit bétail, tu les lui donneras.
fr.B: Donne-lui aussi les prémices de ton grain, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile d’olive, ainsi que la première laine que donnent tes moutons à la tonte.
fr.R: Donne aussi au prêtre la première part de ton grain, de ton vin nouveau et de ton huile d’olive. Et donne-lui la première laine que tu coupes sur tes moutons.

sw.L: Malimbuko ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako mabichi, na malimbuko ya manyoya ya kondoo wako yanayokatwa, utampa.
sw.B: Mpe pia malimbuko ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako ya zeituni, na sufu ya kwanza unayoikata kutoka kwa kondoo wako.
sw.R: Pia mpe kuhani sehemu ya kwanza ya nafaka yako, ya divai yako mpya na ya mafuta yako ya zeituni. Tena mpe sufu ya kwanza unayoikata kutoka kwa kondoo wako.

vi.L: Hoa quả đầu mùa của ngũ cốc ngươi, rượu mới và dầu mới của ngươi, và lông đầu mùa khi xén lông bầy chiên ngươi, ngươi phải đưa cho người ấy.
vi.B: Anh em cũng phải đưa cho thầy tế lễ hoa quả đầu mùa của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu của anh em, cùng với mớ lông đầu tiên khi xén lông chiên.
vi.R: Cũng hãy đưa cho thầy tế lễ phần đầu tiên của ngũ cốc, rượu mới và dầu ô-liu của anh em. Hãy đưa cho ông mớ lông đầu tiên anh em xén từ đàn chiên của mình.

ko.L: 네 곡식과 네 새 포도주와 네 새 기름의 첫 [소산]과 네 양 떼의 털을 깎은 것의 첫 [것]을 너는 그에게 주어라.
ko.B: 너희가 거둔 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름의 첫 소산을 제사장에게 주고, 양털을 깎을 때 처음 깎은 털도 그에게 주어라.
ko.R: 또 여러분이 거둔 곡식과 새 포도주와 올리브기름 가운데서 처음 것을 제사장에게 주십시오. 양털을 깎을 때에도 처음 깎은 털을 그에게 주십시오.

pt.L: As primícias do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite fresco, e as primícias da tosquia do teu rebanho lhe darás.
pt.B: Darás a ele também as primícias do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite, e a primeira lã que as tuas ovelhas derem na tosquia.
pt.R: Dá também ao sacerdote a primeira parte do teu cereal, do teu vinho novo e do teu azeite. E dá a ele a primeira lã que cortares das tuas ovelhas.

decisions.choice: the first: the firstfruits, the first and best of each year's harvest
decisions.reason: The first part of the harvest belonged to the LORD and was given to the priests (Exodus 23:19; Numbers 18:12-13; 26:2). The first of the wool is not named in Numbers 18; Deuteronomy adds it.

decisions.choice: new wine and fresh oil: the new juice of the grapes and the new oil of the olives
decisions.reason: The two words name the fresh produce of the vineyard and the olive grove, here as in 7:13 and 14:23. With grain they are the three main crops of the land.

decisions.choice: to him: to the priest
decisions.reason: "Him" is the priest of verse 3, the one serving at the chosen place.

decisions.choice: olive oil; the first wool your sheep yield at shearing
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "olive oil", the kind meant, and say what the "first of the shearing of your flock" is. Readable says "the priest" for "him".

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel addressed in the singular ("tu Dios", "te"), with the plural_you span only where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15, "you shall listen")
decisions.reason: Moses addresses Israel as one person through the chapter, as the Hebrew singular forms show; the one plural verb in verse 15 speaks to all the people.

decisions.choice: "tu" for Israel addressed in the singular, "vous" where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15)
decisions.reason: French follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: singular forms ("wako", "utampa") for Israel addressed as one, plural ("mtamsikiliza") where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 15)
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "hoa quả đầu mùa" (L, B); "phần đầu tiên" (R)
decisions.reason: The firstfruits (meaning decision), as Exodus 23:16-19 names them.

source.text: כִּ֣י ב֗וֹ בָּחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִכָּל־שְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ לַעֲמֹ֨ד לְשָׁרֵ֧ת בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא וּבָנָ֖יו כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For him has chosen Yahweh your God from all your tribes, to stand to minister in [the] name of Yahweh, he and his sons, all the days.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, him and his sons, all the days.
en.B: Out of all your tribes it is he whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has chosen, he and his sons, to stand and serve in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all time.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God chose the priests and their descendants from all your tribes. They are to stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and serve in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name for all time.

es.L: Porque a él lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios de entre todas tus tribus, para estar en pie y ministrar en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, él y sus hijos, todos los días.
es.B: De todas tus tribus, es a él a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios ha escogido, a él y a sus hijos, para estar de pie y servir en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para siempre.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios escogió a los sacerdotes y a sus descendientes de entre todas tus tribus. Ellos deben estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y servir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre para siempre.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’a choisi parmi toutes tes tribus, pour se tenir [là] et servir au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, lui et ses fils, tous les jours.
fr.B: De toutes tes tribus, c’est lui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a choisi, lui et ses fils, pour se tenir là et servir au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour toujours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a choisi les prêtres et leurs descendants parmi toutes tes tribus. Ils doivent se tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et servir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom pour toujours.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amemchagua yeye kutoka katika makabila yako yote, ili asimame kuhudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yeye na wanawe, siku zote.
sw.B: Katika makabila yako yote, yeye ndiye ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amemchagua, yeye na wanawe, ili wasimame na kuhudumu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aliwachagua makuhani na wazao wao kutoka katika makabila yako yote. Wanapaswa kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kuhudumu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} daima.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã chọn người ấy từ trong mọi chi tộc của ngươi, để đứng phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, người ấy và các con trai người, mọi ngày.
vi.B: Vì trong mọi chi tộc của anh em, chính người ấy được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em chọn, người ấy và các con trai mình, để đứng phục vụ trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mãi mãi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã chọn các thầy tế lễ và con cháu họ từ trong mọi chi tộc của anh em. Họ phải đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và phục vụ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 네 모든 지파 가운데서 그를 택하셔서, 그와 그의 아들들이 언제나 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 섬기게 하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희 모든 지파 가운데서 바로 그를 택하셔서, 그와 그의 자손이 언제까지나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 서서 섬기게 하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 여러분의 모든 지파 가운데서 제사장들과 그 자손을 택하셨습니다. 그들은 언제까지나 그분 앞에 서서 그분의 이름으로 섬길 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, o escolheu dentre todas as tuas tribos, para estar de pé servindo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele e os seus filhos, todos os dias.
pt.B: Pois foi a ele que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, escolheu dentre todas as tuas tribos, a ele e aos seus filhos, para estar ali e servir em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para sempre.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, escolheu os sacerdotes e os seus descendentes dentre todas as tuas tribos. Eles devem ficar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} e servir em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome para sempre.

decisions.choice: him ... he and his sons: Levi's line of priests, chosen from among the tribes
decisions.reason: "Him" comes first in the sentence, for emphasis: of all the tribes, the LORD chose this one. It points back to the priest of verses 3-4 and to the tribe behind him; "his sons" are his descendants after him. 21:5 says the same of "the priests, the sons of Levi".

decisions.choice: to stand to minister: to stand in attendance and serve
decisions.reason: A servant stood before his master, ready to act. The priests stand before the LORD to serve him at the altar (10:8; 17:12).

decisions.choice: in the name of the LORD: as his servants, by his authority
decisions.reason: To serve or bless "in the name" of the LORD is to act for him and with his authority, not on one's own (10:8; 21:5).

decisions.choice: all the days: always, from one generation to the next
decisions.reason: The phrase means for all time; the choice of Levi's line is not for one lifetime only.

decisions.choice: it is he whom ...; the priests and their descendants; stand before him
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the emphasis of "him", placed first in the Hebrew, with "it is he whom". Readable names the priests for "him", which might otherwise seem to mean a single man, and says before whom they stand.

source.text: וְכִֽי־יָבֹ֨א הַלֵּוִ֜י מֵאַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֨יךָ֙ מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם וּבָא֙ בְּכָל־אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if comes the Levite from one of your gates from all Israel where he [is] sojourning there, and he comes with all [the] desire of his soul to the place which will choose Yahweh,

en.L: And if the Levite comes from one of your gates out of all Israel, where he is sojourning, and he comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose,
en.B: Suppose a Levite comes from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he has been living, and he comes because he longs with all his heart to go to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose,
en.R: A Levite may be living in one of your towns somewhere in Israel. He may want with all his heart to go to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will choose.

es.L: Y si el levita viene de una de tus puertas, de todo Israel, donde reside como forastero, y viene con todo el deseo de su alma al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja,
es.B: Supongamos que un levita viene de una de tus ciudades, de cualquier parte de Israel donde haya estado viviendo, y viene porque anhela con todo su corazón ir al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja,
es.R: Un levita puede estar viviendo en una de tus ciudades, en algún lugar de Israel. Puede que desee con todo su corazón ir al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escoja.

fr.L: Et si le Lévite vient de l’une de tes portes, de tout Israël, où il séjourne, et qu’il vienne, de tout le désir de son âme, au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira,
fr.B: Supposons qu’un Lévite vienne de l’une de tes villes, n’importe où en Israël, où il résidait, et qu’il vienne parce qu’il désire de tout son cœur aller au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira,
fr.R: Un Lévite peut habiter dans l’une de tes villes, quelque part en Israël. Il peut désirer de tout son cœur aller au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira.

sw.L: Na Mlawi akija kutoka katika mojawapo ya malango yako, kutoka Israeli yote, mahali anapokaa kama mgeni, akaja kwa shauku yote ya nafsi yake mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua,
sw.B: Tuseme Mlawi anakuja kutoka katika mmojawapo wa miji yako popote katika Israeli alipokuwa akiishi, naye anakuja kwa sababu anatamani kwa moyo wake wote kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua,
sw.R: Huenda Mlawi akawa anaishi katika mmojawapo wa miji yako mahali fulani katika Israeli. Huenda akatamani kwa moyo wake wote kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapachagua.

vi.L: Và nếu người Lê-vi từ một trong các cổng [thành] của ngươi, khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên, là nơi người ấy đang tạm trú, đến với tất cả lòng ao ước của mình đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn,
vi.B: Giả sử một người Lê-vi từ một thành nào đó trong khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên, nơi người ấy đang cư ngụ, đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn vì hết lòng ao ước được đến đó,
vi.R: Có thể một người Lê-vi đang sống trong một thành nào đó của anh em ở bất cứ đâu trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Người ấy hết lòng muốn đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘 가운데 네 성문들 중 어느 한 곳, 곧 그가 나그네로 살던 곳에서 레위인이 나와서, 그의 마음이 몹시 원하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 오면,
ko.B: 어떤 레위인이 이스라엘 어디든 자기가 머물러 살던 성읍을 떠나, 간절한 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 온다고 하자.
ko.R: 어떤 레위인이 이스라엘 어느 성읍에서 살고 있을 수 있습니다. 그런데 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하실 곳으로 가기를 진심으로 원할 수도 있습니다.

pt.L: E, se o levita vier de uma das tuas portas, de todo Israel, onde ele mora como imigrante, e vier com todo o desejo da sua alma ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher,
pt.B: Suponhamos que um levita venha de uma das tuas cidades, de qualquer parte de Israel onde estiver morando, e venha porque deseja de todo o coração ir ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher,
pt.R: Pode ser que um levita esteja morando numa das tuas cidades, em qualquer parte de Israel. Ele pode querer de todo o coração ir ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolher.

decisions.choice: and if: a new case, running to verse 8
decisions.reason: The verse opens a case about the Levites who are not serving at the chosen place: the condition is in this verse, the right he is given follows in verses 7-8.

decisions.choice: your gates; sojourning: the towns where a Levite lived without land of his own
decisions.reason: "Gates" means the towns themselves (12:12; 14:27). The verb is the one used of a resident foreigner: someone who lives in a place without owning land there. Since Levi had no land (verses 1-2), a Levite lived in other people's towns (Judges 17:7; 19:1).

decisions.choice: with all the desire of his soul: because he longs to, of his own free will
decisions.reason: The "soul" here is the self with its desires (12:15, 20). He comes because he wants to serve, not because he is sent.

decisions.choice: the place the LORD will choose: the one place of worship of chapter 12
decisions.reason: With sacrifice brought to one chosen place (12:5-14), Levites living in the towns had no altar near them. This law gives any of them who comes there the right to serve.

decisions.choice: towns; where he has been living; longs with all his heart
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "towns" for "gates", and say plainly what "sojourning" and "all the desire of his soul" mean. Readable makes the condition two short sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: "나그네로 살던" (Literal), "머물러 살던" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one behind "나그네" (ger): a Levite lived in the towns without land of his own. The Literal keeps the link.

decisions.choice: mora como imigrante (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one from which the word for the resident foreigner comes (m2), so Literal says "morar como imigrante", as Leviticus 19:33 does, linking it to "o imigrante"; Balanced and Readable say "morar", as the English says "living".

source.text: וְשֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו כְּכָל־אֶחָיו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and he shall minister in [the] name of Yahweh his God like all his brothers the Levites who [are] standing there before Yahweh.

en.L: then he shall minister in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: he may serve in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God just as all the other Levites do who stand there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then he may serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God there, just like all the other Levites who serve in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} there.

es.L: entonces ministrará en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, como todos sus hermanos los levitas que están allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: podrá servir en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, igual que todos los demás levitas que están allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: he shall minister: he has the right to serve
decisions.reason: The verb sets out what follows from the case of verse 6: the Levite is to be allowed to serve, and those already there may not turn him away.

decisions.reason: "Standing before the LORD" and "ministering in his name" are the words used of the priests in verse 5. Deuteronomy calls the priests "the priests, the Levites" and does not draw the line between priests and other Levites that Numbers 3-4 and 18 draw. The text does not say whether this Levite serves as a priest or in the other work of the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: his brothers: his fellow members of the tribe

decisions.choice: he may serve; the other Levites

decisions.choice: portion like portion they shall eat: he and the Levites already serving have equal shares
decisions.reason: The plural "they" takes in the newcomer and the Levites who already serve. He is to eat from the offerings on the same footing as they do.

decisions.choice: besides his sales by the fathers: apart from what he has from selling family property
alternatives: apart from what he receives through his family
apart from the sale of what his fathers left him
decisions.reason: The phrase is short and hard. Its words are "apart from", "his sales" and "upon the fathers". It most likely means money a Levite had from selling a family possession, such as a house in a Levite town (Leviticus 25:32-34). Such income does not lessen his share at the sanctuary. Other readings take it as payments or gifts that came to him through his father's house.

decisions.choice: even if he has money from selling what came to him from his family
