decisions.choice: makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire: offers a child as a burnt sacrifice
decisions.reason: 12:31 says the nations "burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods". Israel's later kings were condemned for doing the same (2 Kings 16:3; 21:6; Jeremiah 7:31), and Leviticus 18:21 and 20:2-5 forbid giving a child to Molech. The rite is named first, and the list of ways to seek hidden knowledge follows, perhaps because such a sacrifice was also made to win an answer or help from a god (2 Kings 3:27).

decisions.choice: divines divinations, soothsayer, interprets omens, sorcerer: several ways of seeking hidden knowledge or power
decisions.reason: The first is a general term for seeking to learn the future or a god's will, for example by lots or by reading signs (Ezekiel 21:26; 1 Samuel 15:23). The sense of the second is less clear; it may be reading the clouds or telling fortunes. The third is reading omens; Joseph's steward speaks of a cup used for it (Genesis 44:5, 15). The fourth is working magic by spells or charms (Exodus 7:11; 22:17). The exact difference between them is not always known.

decisions.choice: there shall not be found among you anyone: the rule covers every Israelite, man or woman
decisions.reason: The words of the list are masculine, but they describe anyone who does these things. Verse 12 says "everyone who does these", and Exodus 22:17 and Leviticus 20:27 name women among them. The list runs on into verse 11.

decisions.choice: burn ... in the fire as a sacrifice; use magic to learn secret things; read signs to know the future
decisions.reason: Readable says what "pass through the fire" meant, as 12:31 shows, and explains each practice in plain words. Balanced keeps "pass through the fire" and uses "a son or daughter" so that it fits anyone.

decisions.choice: "practicar adivinación", "agorero" (B "decir la buenaventura"), "interpretar/leer presagios", "hechicero" (B "hechicería")
decisions.reason: The four words for seeking hidden knowledge are kept apart. "Adivino" is not used for the first, because it renders the "spiritist" of verse 11, as in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27; "hechicero" is the sorcerer of Exodus 7 and 22.

decisions.choice: "pratiquer la divination", "diseur de bonne aventure", "interprète de présages" (B "lire les présages"), "sorcier" (B "sorcellerie")
decisions.reason: The four words for seeking hidden knowledge are kept apart. "Devin" is not used for the first, because it renders the "spiritist" of verse 11, as in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27; "sorcier" is the sorcerer of Exodus 7.

decisions.choice: "kufanya uaguzi", "mbashiri" (B "kubashiri"), "kupiga ramli", "mchawi" (B "kufanya uchawi")
decisions.reason: The four words for seeking hidden knowledge are kept apart, with the forms of Leviticus 19:26 ("kupiga ramli", "kubashiri") and Exodus 7 and 22 ("mchawi"). "Uaguzi" names divination in general; the "waaguzi wa wafu" of verse 11 are those who consult the dead.

decisions.choice: "bói toán", "thầy bói" / "đoán số mệnh", "xem điềm", "phù thủy"
decisions.reason: Several ways of seeking hidden knowledge or power (meaning decision). Vietnamese has a word for each; "bói toán" and "xem điềm" are the words 2 Kings 21:6 uses, "phù thủy" as Exodus 22:17.

decisions.choice: "점을 치는 자", "길흉을 말하는 자", "징조를 풀이하는 자", "요술을 부리는 자"
decisions.reason: Plain modern words for four kinds of divination and magic, kept distinct; the Korean Bibles' older terms are avoided. "점을 치다" matches Leviticus 19:26 in this translation.

decisions.choice: adivinhação, agoureiro, presságios, feiticeiro (L); adivinhação, ler a sorte, presságios, feitiçaria (B); R as the English
decisions.reason: The practices of verses 10-11 (m2) take the general Portuguese words, which do not tie them to any present-day religion: "adivinhação" for seeking hidden knowledge, "agoureiro" and "ler a sorte" for telling fortunes, "presságios" for omens, "feitiçaria" for sorcery. Readable explains each, as the English Readable does. Literal uses "quem" ("quem faça", "quem pratique"), which covers anyone, man or woman (m3).

source.text: וְחֹבֵ֖ר חָ֑בֶר וְשֹׁאֵ֥ל אוֹב֙ וְיִדְּעֹנִ֔י וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ אֶל־הַמֵּתִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and [one] binding a spell, and [one] asking a medium or a spiritist, and [one] seeking to the dead.

en.L: or one who casts spells, or one who asks a medium or a spiritist, or one who inquires of the dead.
en.B: or cast spells, or consult a medium or a spiritist, or seek answers from the dead.
en.R: No one may cast spells, ask mediums or spiritists to get messages from spirits, or try to get answers from the dead.

es.L: ni quien lance hechizos, ni quien pregunte a un nigromante o a un adivino, ni quien consulte a los muertos.
es.B: ni lance hechizos, ni consulte a un nigromante o a un adivino, ni busque respuestas de los muertos.
es.R: Nadie debe lanzar hechizos, ni pedir a nigromantes o adivinos mensajes de los espíritus, ni tratar de obtener respuestas de los muertos.

fr.L: ni personne qui jette des sorts, qui interroge un nécromancien ou un devin, ou qui consulte les morts.
fr.B: ne jette des sorts, ne consulte un nécromancien ou un devin, ou ne cherche des réponses auprès des morts.
fr.R: Personne ne doit jeter des sorts, ni demander à des nécromanciens ou à des devins des messages venant des esprits, ni essayer d’obtenir des réponses des morts.

sw.L: wala anayeroga, wala anayeuliza kwa mwaguzi wa wafu au kwa mwenye pepo wa uaguzi, wala anayetafuta habari kwa wafu.
sw.B: wala asiroge, wala asiulize kwa mwaguzi wa wafu au kwa mwenye pepo wa uaguzi, wala asitafute majibu kwa wafu.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asiroge, wala asiwaendee waaguzi wa wafu au wenye pepo wa uaguzi ili apate ujumbe kutoka kwa mizimu, wala asijaribu kupata majibu kutoka kwa wafu.

vi.L: hoặc kẻ bỏ bùa, hoặc kẻ cầu hỏi đồng bóng hay thầy đồng, hoặc kẻ cầu vấn người chết.
vi.B: hoặc bỏ bùa, hoặc cầu hỏi đồng bóng hay thầy đồng, hoặc tìm lời đáp từ người chết.
vi.R: Không ai được bỏ bùa, hoặc hỏi đồng bóng hay thầy đồng để nhận lời nhắn từ các linh hồn, hoặc tìm cách hỏi người chết.

ko.L: 주문을 외는 자나, 영매나 무당에게 묻는 자나, 죽은 자들에게 묻는 자가 있어서는 안 된다.
ko.B: 주문을 외거나, 영매나 무당에게 묻거나, 죽은 사람들에게 답을 구해서도 안 된다.
ko.R: 주문을 외거나, 영매나 무당을 찾아가 혼령의 말을 들으려 하거나, 죽은 사람들에게서 답을 얻으려 해서도 안 됩니다.

pt.L: nem quem faça encantamentos, nem quem consulte um médium ou um espírita, nem quem busque os mortos.
pt.B: nem fará encantamentos, nem consultará um médium ou um espírita, nem buscará respostas dos mortos.
pt.R: Ninguém pode fazer feitiços, nem pedir a médiuns ou espíritas que tragam mensagens dos espíritos, nem tentar conseguir respostas dos mortos.

decisions.choice: casts spells: binds by charms or spells
decisions.reason: The words come from a root meaning "bind" or "join". They describe someone who uses spoken charms to bind or control, as with the snake charmer of Psalm 58:6.

decisions.choice: asks a medium or a spiritist: seeks a message from the spirits of the dead
decisions.reason: The first word means a spirit of the dead or the person who calls it up, as the woman at Endor did for Saul (1 Samuel 28:7-15). The second comes from the word "know": a spirit or person claiming hidden knowledge. The pair is forbidden in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27.

decisions.choice: inquires of the dead: tries to learn from the dead what only God can tell
decisions.reason: This sums up the practices just named. Isaiah 8:19 asks the same question: should a people seek the dead on behalf of the living, rather than their God?

decisions.choice: a medium or a spiritist
decisions.reason: The words used for this pair in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27. Readable adds what they were consulted for.

decisions.choice: "đồng bóng hay thầy đồng" for the medium and the spiritist
decisions.reason: The pair 2 Kings 21:6 and 23:24 use for the same two Hebrew words.

decisions.choice: "영매" and "무당"
decisions.reason: As Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27 in this translation.

decisions.choice: um médium ou um espírita
alternatives: pessoas que dizem que podem falar com os mortos (R)
decisions.reason: The pair of Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, 27 (m2), with the words set there in Portuguese, "médiuns e espíritas". As Leviticus 19:31 notes, in Brazil "espírita" also names followers of Spiritism, a present-day religion; the verse speaks of the ancient practice of consulting the dead (m3). Readable adds what they were consulted for, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּֽי־תוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה וּבִגְלַל֙ הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מוֹרִ֥ישׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For [an] abomination of Yahweh [is] every [one] doing these, and because of the abominations the these Yahweh your God [is] dispossessing them from before you.

en.L: For an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] everyone who does these [things], and because of these abominations {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is dispossessing them from before you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests anyone who does these things. It is for these detestable practices that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is driving those nations out before you.
en.R: Anyone who does these things is disgusting to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It is because of these disgusting things that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is forcing those nations out of the land ahead of you.

es.L: Porque abominación es para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} todo el que hace estas [cosas], y por causa de estas abominaciones {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios los desposee de delante de ti.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} detesta a cualquiera que hace estas cosas. Es por estas prácticas detestables que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios expulsa a esas naciones delante de ti.
es.R: Cualquiera que hace estas cosas es repugnante para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Por estas cosas repugnantes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios está echando a esas naciones de la tierra delante de ti.

fr.L: Car une abomination pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [c’est] quiconque fait ces [choses], et c’est à cause de ces abominations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu les dépossède devant toi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a en horreur quiconque fait ces choses. C’est à cause de ces pratiques détestables que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu chasse ces nations devant toi.
fr.R: Quiconque fait ces choses est dégoûtant aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’est à cause de ces choses dégoûtantes que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu chasse ces nations du pays devant toi.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni chukizo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kila mtu atendaye [mambo] haya, na kwa sababu ya machukizo haya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anawafukuza mbele yako.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anamchukia kabisa mtu yeyote anayefanya mambo haya. Ni kwa sababu ya matendo haya ya kuchukiza ndiyo maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anayafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yako.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayefanya mambo haya anamchukiza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ni kwa sababu ya mambo haya ya kinyaa ndiyo maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anayafukuza mataifa hayo kutoka katika nchi mbele yako.

vi.L: Vì hễ ai làm những [điều] này [là] điều ghê tởm đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và vì những điều ghê tởm này mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đang đuổi chúng khỏi trước mặt ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghê tởm bất cứ ai làm những điều đó. Chính vì những thói ghê tởm ấy mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang đuổi các dân tộc kia khỏi trước mặt anh em.
vi.R: Ai làm những điều ấy đều là kẻ ghê tởm đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chính vì những việc ghê tởm đó mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang đuổi các dân tộc ấy ra khỏi xứ trước khi anh em vào.

ko.L: 이런 [일들을] 하는 자는 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 가증하기 때문이다. 그리고 이 가증한 일들 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 네 앞에서 그들을 쫓아내시는 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이런 일을 하는 사람을 모두 가증하게 여기신다. 바로 이런 가증한 일들 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희 앞에서 그 민족들을 쫓아내시는 것이다.
ko.R: 이런 일을 하는 사람은 누구든지 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 역겨워하십니다. 바로 이런 역겨운 일들 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 그 민족들을 여러분 앞에서 그 땅에서 쫓아내시는 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque [é] abominação {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} todo aquele que faz estas [coisas], e por causa destas abominações {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, as está expulsando de diante de ti.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} considera abominável todo aquele que faz essas coisas. É por causa dessas práticas abomináveis que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está expulsando aquelas nações de diante de ti.
pt.R: Quem faz essas coisas é abominável para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. É por causa dessas coisas abomináveis que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está expulsando aquelas nações da terra, à tua frente.

decisions.choice: an abomination to the LORD is everyone who does these: the person, and not only the act, is detestable to him
decisions.reason: The verse does not only call the practices detestable, as verse 9 does, but the person who does them. The same is said of other wrongs in 22:5 and 25:16.

decisions.choice: because of these abominations the LORD is driving them out: the nations lose the land for their own wickedness
decisions.reason: Israel does not receive the land because it is more righteous than others, but because of the wickedness of the nations living in it (9:4-5). Leviticus 18:24-28 says the land itself vomits out those who defile it, and warns Israel that it will do the same to them.

decisions.choice: is dispossessing: an action already under way
decisions.reason: The participle presents the driving out as happening now, as Israel stands at the edge of the land.

decisions.choice: those nations
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "them" are: the nations of verse 9. Readable says "out of the land" for "from before you". Balanced turns "an abomination to the LORD is everyone who does these" into "the LORD detests anyone who does these things".

source.text: תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Blameless you shall be with Yahweh your God.

en.L: Blameless you shall be with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: You are to be blameless in your loyalty to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Be completely faithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Irreprochable serás con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Sé irreprochable en tu lealtad {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.R: Sé completamente fiel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios.

fr.L: Irréprochable tu seras avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: Sois irréprochable dans ta fidélité envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.R: Sois entièrement fidèle {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu.

sw.L: Bila lawama utakuwa pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Uwe bila lawama katika uaminifu wako kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.R: Uwe mwaminifu kabisa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.

vi.L: Trọn vẹn ngươi phải ở với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi.
vi.B: Anh em phải trọn vẹn trong lòng trung thành với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.R: Hãy hết lòng trung tín với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.

ko.L: 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님과 함께 흠이 없어야 한다.
ko.B: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 온전히 충성하여 흠이 없어야 한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께 온 마음으로 충성하십시오.

pt.L: Íntegro serás com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus.
pt.B: Serás íntegro na tua lealdade {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus.
pt.R: Sê totalmente fiel {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus.

decisions.choice: blameless: whole, wholehearted, with undivided loyalty
decisions.reason: The word means complete or sound, as an animal without defect (Exodus 12:5). Of a person it describes a life given wholly to God (Genesis 6:9; 17:1; Joshua 24:14). Here it means turning to the LORD alone, and not to other powers for guidance.

decisions.choice: blameless you shall be with the LORD: the word is placed first for emphasis, and "with" speaks of the relationship
decisions.reason: "Blameless" stands first in the sentence. "With the LORD" means in your dealings with him; the same phrase is used of a heart that is whole with the LORD (1 Kings 8:61).

decisions.choice: blameless in your loyalty to; completely faithful to
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "blameless" and says what "with the LORD" means here, a loyalty to him. Readable gives the sense of the whole: a loyalty that is complete.

decisions.choice: "trọn vẹn" (L, B); "hết lòng trung tín" (R) for tamim
decisions.reason: Whole, wholehearted, with undivided loyalty (meaning decision); "trọn vẹn" keeps both wholeness and integrity, and Literal keeps it first for emphasis.

decisions.choice: "흠이 없다" (Literal, Balanced), "온 마음으로 충성하다" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Tamim is wholeness of loyalty, not sinless perfection; "흠 없는" is also the term sheet's word for animals without defect, which the same Hebrew word describes.

decisions.choice: íntegro (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Íntegro" says what the word means of a person (m1), whole and undivided in loyalty; "perfeito", the older rendering, suggests a life without any fault, and "irrepreensível" only that no one can blame you.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־מְעֹנְנִ֥ים וְאֶל־קֹסְמִ֖ים יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְאַתָּ֕ה לֹ֣א כֵ֔ן נָ֛תַןלְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the nations these which you [are] dispossessing them, to soothsayers and to diviners they listen; but you, not so has given to you Yahweh your God.

en.L: For these nations, whom you are dispossessing, listen to soothsayers and to diviners; but as for you, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has not allowed you [to do] so.
en.B: The nations you are about to dispossess pay attention to fortune-tellers and diviners. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has not allowed you to do the same.
en.R: The nations you are driving out listen to people who tell fortunes and use magic to learn secret things. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God does not allow you to do that.

es.L: Porque estas naciones que tú vas a desposeer escuchan a agoreros y a los que practican adivinaciones; pero a ti, no así te lo ha permitido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Las naciones que estás a punto de desposeer prestan atención a los que dicen la buenaventura y a los que practican la adivinación. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios no te ha permitido hacer lo mismo.
es.R: Las naciones que estás echando escuchan a gente que predice el futuro y usa la magia para conocer cosas secretas. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios no te permite hacer eso.

fr.L: Car ces nations que tu dépossèdes écoutent les diseurs de bonne aventure et ceux qui pratiquent la divination ; mais toi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ne t’a pas permis [d’agir] ainsi.
fr.B: Les nations que tu vas déposséder prêtent l’oreille aux diseurs de bonne aventure et à ceux qui pratiquent la divination. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ne t’a pas permis d’en faire autant.
fr.R: Les nations que tu chasses écoutent des gens qui prédisent l’avenir et qui utilisent la magie pour connaître des choses cachées. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ne te permet pas de faire cela.

sw.L: Kwa maana mataifa haya unayoyafukuza huwasikiliza wabashiri na wafanyao uaguzi; lakini wewe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hakukuruhusu [kufanya] hivyo.
sw.B: Mataifa unayokaribia kuyafukuza huwasikiliza wabashiri na wafanyao uaguzi. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hajakuruhusu kufanya vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Mataifa unayoyafukuza huwasikiliza watu wanaotabiri bahati na kutumia uganga ili kujua mambo ya siri. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hakuruhusu kufanya hivyo.

vi.L: Vì các dân tộc mà ngươi đang đuổi đi nghe theo thầy bói và kẻ làm bói toán; còn ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi không cho ngươi [làm] như vậy.
vi.B: Các dân tộc anh em sắp đuổi đi vẫn nghe theo thầy bói và kẻ làm bói toán. Còn anh em, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em không cho phép anh em làm như vậy.
vi.R: Các dân tộc anh em đang đuổi đi nghe theo những người xem bói và dùng tà thuật để biết những điều bí ẩn. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em không cho phép anh em làm như thế.

ko.L: 네가 쫓아낼 이 민족들은 길흉을 말하는 자들과 점을 치는 자들의 말을 듣지만, 너에게는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 그렇게 [하도록] 허락하지 않으셨다.
ko.B: 너희가 쫓아낼 이 민족들은 길흉을 말하는 자들과 점쟁이들의 말에 귀를 기울인다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서는 너희에게 그런 일을 허락하지 않으셨다.
ko.R: 여러분이 쫓아낼 민족들은 운수를 점치는 사람들과 마술로 숨겨진 일을 알아내려는 사람들의 말을 듣습니다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서는 여러분이 그렇게 하는 것을 허락하지 않으십니다.

pt.L: Porque estas nações, que tu estás desapossando, ouvem agoureiros e adivinhos; mas a ti {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, não permitiu [fazer] assim.
pt.B: As nações que estás para desapossar dão ouvidos a agoureiros e adivinhos. Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, não te permitiu fazer o mesmo.
pt.R: As nações que estás expulsando ouvem pessoas que leem a sorte e usam magia para descobrir coisas escondidas. Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, não te deixa fazer isso.

decisions.choice: but you: Israel is set apart from the nations
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is written out and placed first, to set Israel against "these nations".

decisions.choice: has not allowed you so: has not permitted you to do this
alternatives: has not given you such people
decisions.reason: The verb is "give", which with this phrase can mean "permit" (Genesis 20:6; Judges 15:1). It may also mean that the LORD has not given Israel such people as its guides; verse 15 then says what he does give instead, a prophet.

decisions.choice: soothsayers and diviners: two of the kinds named in verse 10
decisions.reason: The two words sum up the list in verses 10-11.

decisions.choice: fortune-tellers and diviners; pay attention to; the same; driving out
decisions.reason: Balanced says "fortune-tellers" for the second word of verse 10, and Readable explains both. "Do the same" and "do that" give the sense of "so": listening to such people. Readable says "driving out" for "dispossess", as settled for Deuteronomy.

source.text: נָבִ֨יא מִקִּרְבְּךָ֤ מֵאַחֶ֨יךָ֙ כָּמֹ֔נִי יָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֵלָ֖יו תִּשְׁמָעֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: A prophet from your midst, from your brothers, like me, will raise up for you Yahweh your God; to him you shall listen,

en.L: A prophet from your midst, from your brothers, like me, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will raise up for you; to him you shall listen,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will raise up a prophet for you like me, one of your own {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}} from among you. It is to him you must listen.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will give you a prophet like me. He will be one of your own people. You must listen to him.

es.L: Un profeta de en medio de ti, de entre tus hermanos, como yo, te levantará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios; a él {{plural_you:escucharán|escucharéis}},
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te levantará un profeta como yo, uno de tus propios compatriotas, de en medio de ti. Es a él a quien {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} escuchar.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te dará un profeta como yo. Saldrá de tu propio pueblo. {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que escucharlo.

fr.L: Un prophète du milieu de toi, d’entre tes frères, comme moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te [le] suscitera ; lui, vous l’écouterez,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu suscitera pour toi un prophète semblable à moi, l’un de tes {{gender:compatriotes|frères}}, issu du milieu de toi. C’est lui que vous devez écouter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donnera un prophète comme moi. Il viendra de ton propre peuple. Vous devrez l’écouter.

sw.L: Nabii kutoka katikati yako, kutoka kwa ndugu zako, kama mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakuinulia; yeye mtamsikiliza,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakuinulia nabii kama mimi, mmoja wa ndugu zako Waisraeli kutoka miongoni mwako. Yeye ndiye mnayepaswa kumsikiliza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakupa nabii kama mimi. Atatoka miongoni mwa watu wako mwenyewe. Ni lazima mumsikilize.

vi.L: Một nhà tiên tri từ giữa ngươi, từ anh em ngươi, giống như tôi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi sẽ dấy lên cho ngươi; các ngươi phải nghe người ấy,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ dấy lên cho anh em một nhà tiên tri giống như tôi, là một người trong vòng đồng bào của anh em. Anh em phải nghe theo người ấy.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ ban cho anh em một nhà tiên tri giống như tôi. Người ấy sẽ là một người trong dân của anh em. Anh em phải nghe lời người ấy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 네 가운데서, 네 형제들 가운데서 나와 같은 예언자 하나를 너를 위하여 세우실 것이니, 너희는 그의 말을 들어라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희 가운데서, 너희 {{gender:동족|형제}} 가운데서 나와 같은 예언자 하나를 너희에게 세워 주실 것이다. 너희는 그의 말을 들어야 한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 저와 같은 예언자 하나를 여러분에게 보내 주실 것입니다. 그는 여러분과 같은 이스라엘 사람일 것입니다. 여러분은 그의 말을 들어야 합니다.

pt.L: Um profeta do meio de ti, dentre os teus irmãos, como eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, levantará para ti; a ele vocês ouvirão,
pt.B: Do meio do teu povo, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, levantará para ti um profeta como eu, um dos teus {{gender:compatriotas|irmãos}}. É a ele que vocês devem ouvir.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, vai te dar um profeta como eu. Ele virá do meio do teu próprio povo. Vocês devem escutá-lo.

decisions.choice: a prophet: placed first, in contrast to the diviners
decisions.reason: The word "prophet" opens the sentence. In place of the soothsayers and diviners of the nations (verse 14), the LORD will give Israel someone through whom he himself speaks.

decisions.choice: like me: a prophet who stands between God and the people as Moses did
decisions.reason: Moses received the LORD's words and passed them on, because the people could not bear to hear God's voice themselves (verse 16; 5:23-28). The prophet like Moses will do the same: he speaks only what God gives him (verse 18).

decisions.choice: a prophet: one prophet in the wording; it can mean each true prophet in turn and was also read of one prophet still to come
alternatives: the line of prophets the LORD will send
decisions.reason: The noun is singular. Verses 20-22 speak of any prophet who claims to speak for the LORD, and so the promise can be read of the line of true prophets after Moses. 34:10 says that no prophet had yet arisen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face, and in later times Israel looked for a single prophet to come (John 1:21; 6:14).

decisions.choice: cited in the New Testament: Acts 3:22-23 and 7:37
decisions.reason: In Acts 3:22-23 Peter quotes verses 15 and 19, joined with words from Leviticus 23:29, and applies them to Jesus; in Acts 7:37 Stephen quotes verse 15. Within Deuteronomy the promise answers Israel's request at Horeb and gives the rule by which every prophet is to be judged (verses 16-22).

decisions.choice: from your brothers; you shall listen: an Israelite, and all the people are to obey
decisions.reason: "Your brothers" means fellow Israelites: the prophet will not be a foreigner like the diviners of the nations. "You shall listen" is plural, addressed to all; to listen to someone is to obey him. The sentence runs on into verse 16.

decisions.choice: your fellow Israelites
decisions.reason: "Brothers" means fellow Israelites here, men and women, as in 1:16; Balanced says so, with "brothers" as the alternative. Literal keeps "your brothers"; Readable says "your own people". Balanced shows with "It is to him" that the Hebrew puts "to him" first.

decisions.choice: will give you
decisions.reason: Readable says "give" for "raise up", that is, cause a prophet to appear among the people.

decisions.choice: "te levantará" (L, B), "te dará" (R); "tú" for the promise, plural_you span for "escucharán" ("escucharéis")
decisions.reason: The verbs match the Spanish of Acts 3:22 and 7:37, which quote this verse ("levantará", R "dará"). The Hebrew gives the promise to Israel as one ("you" singular) and the command to listen to all the people (plural), so Spanish changes number in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "tus propios compatriotas", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has a gender setting for "fellow Israelites|brothers", Spanish "compatriotas" already includes men and women, as elsewhere in Deuteronomy, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "te [le] suscitera" (L), "suscitera pour toi" (B), "te donnera" (R); "tu" for the promise, "vous" for "vous l'écouterez"
decisions.reason: The verbs match the French of Acts 3:22 and 7:37, which quote this verse. The Hebrew gives the promise to Israel as one ("you" singular) and the command to listen to all the people (plural), so French changes from "tu" to "vous" in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "atakuinulia" (L, B), "atakupa" (R); singular for the promise, plural "mtamsikiliza" for the command
decisions.reason: The verbs match the Swahili of Acts 3:22 ("atawainulia", R "atawapa"), which quotes this verse; here the Hebrew "you" of the promise is singular. The command to listen is plural, addressed to all the people, so Swahili changes number in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "đồng bào" with no gender span (B)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced puts "fellow Israelites" under the gender setting; "đồng bào" already includes men and women, so Vietnamese needs no span.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (L) for "you shall listen"
decisions.reason: The verb is plural in the Hebrew while the rest of the verse is singular; Literal keeps the change, as the term sheet asks for Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "예언자" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide's settled preference for the modern word, and as the Korean of Acts 3:22 and 7:37 in this translation, where this verse is quoted.

decisions.choice: "너를 위하여 ... 너희는"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shifts from singular "you" to plural "you shall listen"; the Literal keeps the shift, as the English Literal keeps the Hebrew number elsewhere.

decisions.choice: levantará ... um profeta como eu; a ele vocês ouvirão (L); Vocês devem ouvi-lo (B); Vocês devem escutá-lo (R)
decisions.reason: Peter and Stephen quote this verse (m4), so each level keeps the Portuguese of Acts 3:22 and 7:37 where the Hebrew allows: "levantará para ... um profeta como eu", "a ele vocês ouvirão" (L), "Vocês devem ouvi-lo" (B), "dar ... um profeta como eu" and "Ele virá do meio do ... povo" (R). Acts says "vocês" throughout; Deuteronomy's Hebrew is singular until "you shall listen", which is plural (m5), so Portuguese says "tu" and then "vocês", in sentences of their own at Balanced and Readable. Acts puts the pronouns for the prophet under the deity_pronoun setting, since it applies them to Jesus; here the prophet is spoken of plainly, as in the English.

decisions.choice: {{gender:compatriotas|irmãos}}
decisions.reason: As 1:16 has it in Portuguese: "brothers" means fellow Israelites, men and women (m5), so Balanced says "compatriotas" by default, with "irmãos" as the traditional alternative, where the English has the same setting. The same in verse 18.

source.text: כְּכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בְּחֹרֵ֔ב בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת־קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י וְאֶת־הָאֵ֨שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לֹֽא־אֶרְאֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד וְלֹ֥א אָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: according to all that you asked from with Yahweh your God at Horeb on [the] day of the assembly, saying, Not let me again hear [the] voice of Yahweh my God, and the fire the great the this not let me see again, and not I will die.

en.L: according to all that you asked of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, 'Let me not hear again the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, and this great fire let me not see anymore, so that I do not die.'
en.B: It is what you requested from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, 'I must not hear the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God again or look at this great fire any longer, or I will die.'
en.R: This is what you asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for at Mount Horeb, on the day the people gathered there. You said, 'Do not let me hear the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God again or see this great fire any more. If I do, I will die.'

es.L: conforme a todo lo que pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb el día de la asamblea, diciendo: “Que no vuelva yo a oír la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios, ni vea más este gran fuego, para que no muera”.
es.B: Es lo que pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Horeb el día de la asamblea, cuando dijiste: “No debo oír otra vez la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios ni mirar más este gran fuego, o moriré”.
es.R: Esto es lo que le pediste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en el monte Horeb, el día en que el pueblo se reunió allí. Dijiste: “No quiero volver a oír la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mi Dios ni ver más este gran fuego. Si lo hago, moriré”.

fr.L: selon tout ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, le jour de l’assemblée, en disant : “Que je n’entende plus la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu, et que je ne voie plus ce grand feu, afin que je ne meure pas.”
fr.B: C’est ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à l’Horeb, le jour de l’assemblée, quand tu as dit : “Je ne dois plus entendre la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu ni regarder plus longtemps ce grand feu, sinon je mourrai.”
fr.R: C’est ce que tu as demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu au mont Horeb, le jour où le peuple s’y était rassemblé. Tu as dit : “Je ne veux plus entendre la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} mon Dieu ni voir ce grand feu. Sinon, je vais mourir.”

sw.L: kulingana na yote uliyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu siku ya kusanyiko, ukisema, 'Nisisikie tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, wala nisiuone tena moto huu mkubwa, nisije nikafa.'
sw.B: Ndivyo ulivyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Horebu siku ya kusanyiko, uliposema, 'Sipaswi kusikia tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu wala kuutazama tena moto huu mkubwa, la sivyo nitakufa.'
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo ulivyomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kule Mlima Horebu, siku watu walipokusanyika huko. Ulisema, 'Sitaki kusikia tena sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu wala kuuona tena moto huu mkubwa. Nikifanya hivyo, nitakufa.'

vi.L: theo mọi điều ngươi đã cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi tại Hô-rếp vào ngày nhóm họp, rằng: 'Xin cho tôi đừng nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi nữa, và đừng cho tôi thấy ngọn lửa lớn này nữa, để tôi khỏi chết.'
vi.B: Đó chính là điều anh em đã xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em tại Hô-rếp vào ngày toàn dân nhóm họp, khi anh em nói: 'Tôi không thể nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi thêm nữa, cũng không thể nhìn ngọn lửa lớn này thêm nữa, kẻo tôi chết mất.'
vi.R: Đây là điều anh em đã xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em tại núi Hô-rếp, vào ngày dân chúng nhóm lại ở đó. Anh em đã nói: 'Xin đừng để tôi nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời tôi nữa, hay thấy ngọn lửa lớn này nữa. Nếu không, tôi sẽ chết.'

ko.L: 이것은 총회의 날에 호렙에서 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께 구한 모든 것대로이다. 그때 너는 '내가 다시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 내 하나님의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 이 큰 불을 더는 보지 않겠다. 그래야 내가 죽지 않을 것이다' 하고 말하였다.
ko.B: 이것은 너희가 총회의 날에 호렙에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께 구한 바로 그것이다. 그때 너희는 '제가 다시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 이 큰 불을 더는 보지 않게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 제가 죽겠습니다' 하고 말하였다.
ko.R: 이것은 여러분이 호렙 산에 모인 날 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께 구한 것입니다. 그때 여러분은 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님의 목소리를 다시는 듣지 않게 해 주십시오. 이 큰 불도 더는 보지 않게 해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 우리가 죽겠습니다' 하고 말하였습니다.

pt.L: conforme tudo o que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, em Horebe, no dia da assembleia, dizendo: 'Que eu não volte a ouvir a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, e este grande fogo não veja mais, para que eu não morra.'
pt.B: Foi isso que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, em Horebe, no dia da assembleia, quando disseste: 'Não posso mais ouvir a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, nem olhar para este grande fogo, senão morrerei.'
pt.R: Foi isso que pediste {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o teu Deus, no monte Horebe, no dia em que o povo se reuniu ali. Disseste: 'Não quero ouvir de novo a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o meu Deus, nem ver mais este grande fogo. Se isso acontecer, vou morrer.'

decisions.choice: what you asked at Horeb: the people's plea after they heard the ten words
decisions.reason: The story is told in 5:23-28 (and Exodus 20:18-21): terrified by the voice from the fire, the people asked Moses to go near and hear God for them. The prophet of verse 15 is God's answer to that request.

decisions.choice: the day of the assembly: the day all Israel gathered at the mountain
decisions.reason: This is the day the LORD spoke the ten words to the assembled people from the fire (9:10; 10:4).

decisions.choice: you asked; my God; let me not: the people speak as one
decisions.reason: "You" and "I" are singular. The whole people is spoken of, and speaks, as one person.

decisions.choice: and not I will die: so that I do not die
decisions.reason: The last clause gives the reason for the request: to go on hearing God's voice would be death (5:25).

decisions.choice: It is what you requested; I must not hear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence here, since verse 15 has already been closed there. Balanced gives the wish "let me not hear" as "I must not hear". Readable says "Mount Horeb", as in 5:2, and says what "the day of the assembly" was.

decisions.choice: "총회" (Literal, Balanced), "모인 날" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Qahal is the term sheet's "총회".

decisions.choice: pediste, disseste (tu); eu, o meu Deus (the people as one)
decisions.reason: The people ask and speak as one person (m3), so Portuguese keeps "tu" for "you asked" and "eu" in the quotation at every level, as the English does. "A assembleia" for the gathered people (m2), as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, They have done well [in] what they have spoken.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They have done well [in] what they have spoken.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They have spoken well.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'They were right to say this.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Han hecho bien [en] lo que han dicho.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Han hablado bien.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Tienen razón en decir esto.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont bien fait de dire ce qu’ils ont dit.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont bien parlé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Ils ont eu raison de dire cela.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Wamefanya vema [katika] yale waliyoyasema.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Wamesema vema.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Wako sahihi kusema hivyo.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Chúng đã nói phải.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Họ nói phải lắm.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi: 'Họ nói như vậy là đúng.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하셨다. '그들이 말한 것은 잘한 것이다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하셨다. '그들의 말이 옳다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 제게 말씀하셨습니다. '그들이 그렇게 말한 것은 옳다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Fizeram bem [no] que falaram.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Eles falaram bem.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me disse: 'Eles estão certos em dizer isso.

decisions.choice: they have done well in what they have spoken: the LORD's approval of the people's request
decisions.reason: The same words are reported in 5:28. The people were right to know they could not stand before God's voice, and the LORD granted what they asked.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words run from here to the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: In verses 18-20 the LORD speaks of himself as "I" and of Moses as "you". In verse 21 the LORD is spoken of again in the third person, so Moses' own words most likely take up again there.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks, opened here and closed at the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: The whole chapter is inside Moses' speech, which opened at 5:1. Words he quotes take single quotation marks, so the LORD's words open here and close at the end of verse 20.

decisions.choice: In the LORD's words of verses 17-20, God says "Ta", calls Moses "ngươi" (L) / "con" (B, R) and speaks of Israel as "chúng" (L) / "họ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled address of God to Moses in these books, quoted here inside Moses' speech.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks, opened here and closed at the end of verse 20
decisions.reason: As the English (m2) and as 4:10 and 10:1 set it in Portuguese: Moses' speech, open since 5:1, is in double quotes, so the LORD's words to him take single quotes; in them God says "tu" to Moses.

source.text: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָהֶ֛ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹךָ וְנָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יו וְדִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A prophet I will raise up for them from [the] midst of their brothers, like you, and I will put my words in his mouth, and he will speak to them all that I command him.

en.L: A prophet I will raise up for them from the midst of their brothers, like you, and I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him.
en.B: From among their {{gender:fellow Israelites|brothers}} I will raise up a prophet for them who is like you. I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words in his mouth, and he will pass on to them all that I command him.
en.R: I will give them a prophet like you from among their own people. I will give him {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words to say, and he will tell them everything I command him.

es.L: Un profeta les levantaré de en medio de sus hermanos, como tú, y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras en su boca, y él les hablará todo lo que yo le mande.
es.B: De entre sus propios compatriotas les levantaré un profeta como tú. Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras en su boca, y él les transmitirá todo lo que yo le mande.
es.R: Les daré un profeta como tú, de su propio pueblo. Le daré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras para que las diga, y él les dirá todo lo que yo le mande.

fr.L: Un prophète, je [le] leur susciterai du milieu de leurs frères, comme toi, et je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dans sa bouche, et il leur dira tout ce que je lui commanderai.
fr.B: Du milieu de leurs {{gender:compatriotes|frères}}, je leur susciterai un prophète semblable à toi. Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dans sa bouche, et il leur transmettra tout ce que je lui commanderai.
fr.R: Je leur donnerai un prophète comme toi, venu de leur propre peuple. Je lui donnerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles à dire, et il leur dira tout ce que je lui commanderai.

sw.L: Nabii nitawainulia kutoka katikati ya ndugu zao, kama wewe, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kinywani mwake, naye atawaambia yote nitakayomwamuru.
sw.B: Kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao Waisraeli nitawainulia nabii aliye kama wewe. Nitatia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kinywani mwake, naye atawafikishia yote nitakayomwamuru.
sw.R: Nitawapa nabii kama wewe kutoka miongoni mwa watu wao wenyewe. Nitampa maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ayaseme, naye atawaambia kila kitu nitakachomwamuru.

vi.L: Một nhà tiên tri, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho chúng từ giữa anh em chúng, giống như ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong miệng người ấy, và người ấy sẽ nói với chúng mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho người ấy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ dấy lên cho họ, từ giữa đồng bào của họ, một nhà tiên tri giống như con. Ta sẽ đặt lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong miệng người ấy, và người ấy sẽ truyền lại cho họ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền dặn.
vi.R: Ta sẽ ban cho họ một nhà tiên tri giống như con, là người trong dân của họ. Ta sẽ cho người ấy lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để nói, và người ấy sẽ nói với họ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền dặn.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 위하여 그들의 형제들 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 세우고, 내 말을 그의 입에 두겠다. 그러면 그는 내가 그에게 명령하는 모든 것을 그들에게 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들의 {{gender:동족|형제}} 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 그들에게 세워 주겠다. 내가 내 말을 그의 입에 두면, 그는 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 전할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그들 가운데서 너와 같은 예언자 하나를 그들에게 보내 주겠다. 그가 할 말을 내가 그에게 주겠다. 그러면 그는 내가 명령하는 것을 모두 그들에게 말해 줄 것이다.

pt.L: Um profeta levantarei para eles do meio dos seus irmãos, como tu, e porei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras na sua boca, e ele lhes falará tudo o que eu lhe ordenar.
pt.B: Dentre os seus {{gender:compatriotas|irmãos}} levantarei para eles um profeta como tu. Porei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras na boca dele, e ele lhes transmitirá tudo o que eu lhe ordenar.
pt.R: Vou dar a eles um profeta como tu, do meio do próprio povo deles. Vou dar a ele as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras para dizer, e ele vai dizer a eles tudo o que eu mandar.

decisions.choice: a prophet ... like you: the promise of verse 15, now in the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: Moses passes on in verse 15 what the LORD said to him here. "Like you" means like Moses; see the note on verse 15.

decisions.choice: I will put my words in his mouth: I will give him the very words to speak
decisions.reason: The prophet does not speak his own thoughts but the LORD's words. The same picture is used of Aaron speaking for Moses (Exodus 4:15-16), of Balaam (Numbers 22:38; 23:5) and of Jeremiah's call (Jeremiah 1:9).

decisions.choice: he shall speak to them all that I command him: all of it, and nothing of his own
decisions.reason: The prophet must pass on the whole of what the LORD commands, and verse 20 shows he may add nothing to it. Moses himself did this (1:3; 4:2).

decisions.choice: their fellow Israelites / their own people
decisions.reason: As in verse 15. Balanced says "pass on to them" for "speak to them", since the words are the LORD's. Readable says "give him my words to say" for the picture of putting words in his mouth.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל־דְּבָרַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּשְׁמִ֑י אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] the man who not will listen to my words which he will speak in my name, I, I will require [it] from with him.

en.L: And it shall be [that] the {{gender:person|man}} who does not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words that he speaks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will require [it] of him.
en.B: If anyone does not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words that the prophet speaks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will hold that person responsible.
en.R: If anyone will not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words when the prophet speaks for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will make that person answer to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que no escuche {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras que él hable en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, yo mismo se lo demandaré.
es.B: Si alguien no escucha {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras que el profeta hable en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, yo mismo le pediré cuentas a esa persona.
es.R: Si alguien no quiere escuchar {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras cuando el profeta hable de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} parte, yo mismo haré que esa persona {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rinda cuentas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} qui n’écoutera pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles qu’il dira en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je lui en demanderai compte.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un n’écoute pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles que le prophète dira en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui en demanderai compte.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un refuse d’écouter {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles quand le prophète parle de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} part, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui lui demanderai des comptes.

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] mtu asiyesikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} atakayoyasema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamdai.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asiyesikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ambayo nabii anayasema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamwajibisha.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote akikataa kusikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nabii anaposema kwa niaba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitamfanya ajibu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, người nào không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà người ấy nói trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đòi [điều đó] nơi người ấy.
vi.B: Nếu ai không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà nhà tiên tri nói nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bắt người ấy chịu trách nhiệm.
vi.R: Nếu ai không chịu nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khi nhà tiên tri nói thay cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bắt người ấy phải trả lời với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 내 이름으로 말하는 내 말을 듣지 않는 사람이 있으면, 내가 친히 그에게서 [그것을] 따질 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 그 예언자가 내 이름으로 전하는 내 말을 듣지 않으면, 내가 친히 그 사람에게 책임을 묻겠다.
ko.R: 누구든지 그 예언자가 나를 대신하여 전하는 내 말을 듣지 않으면, 내가 친히 그 사람에게 그 책임을 따지겠다.

pt.L: E será [que] {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} que não ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras que ele falar em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, eu mesmo lhe pedirei contas.
pt.B: Se alguém não ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras que o profeta disser em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, eu mesmo pedirei contas a essa pessoa.
pt.R: Se alguém não quiser ouvir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras quando o profeta falar por {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, eu mesmo vou fazer essa pessoa prestar contas a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

decisions.choice: I will require it of him: I will hold him to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or demand. Used against a person it means calling him to answer for a wrong, as God requires a life for a life in Genesis 9:5 and demands the blood of the lost from the careless watchman in Ezekiel 3:18. When Acts 3:23 quotes this verse, it gives the outcome in words from Leviticus 23:29: being cut off from the people.

decisions.choice: my words which he speaks in my name: the LORD's own words, spoken by the prophet with his authority
decisions.reason: To refuse the prophet is to refuse God, because the words are God's (verse 18).

decisions.choice: the man who does not listen: anyone, man or woman; and "I" is emphatic
decisions.reason: "The man" here means any person. The pronoun "I" is written out before the verb: the LORD himself will deal with the one who refuses.

decisions.choice: the person
decisions.reason: Literal says "the person", since anyone is meant, with "the man" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: If anyone ...; the prophet; hold that person responsible; when the prophet speaks for me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the sentence into an "if" clause and name the prophet for "he". Readable says "speaks for me" for "speaks in my name".

decisions.choice: eu mesmo, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English puts "Myself" under the deity_pronoun setting. In Portuguese the emphasis (m3) falls on "eu", which takes no span for God (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7), and "mesmo" is an adjective agreeing with it, not a pronoun, so it is written plainly. "Pedir contas" says the sense of "require it of him" (m1) at every level.

source.text: אַ֣ךְ הַנָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְדַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּשְׁמִ֗י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־צִוִּיתִיו֙ לְדַבֵּ֔ר וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּשֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וּמֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֥יא הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: But the prophet who acts presumptuously to speak a word in my name that not I commanded him to speak, and who speaks in [the] name of other gods, and will die the prophet the that.

en.L: But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.'
en.B: But a prophet who dares to speak a word in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet must die.'
en.R: But suppose a prophet dares to say something in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name that I did not tell him to say, or he speaks for other gods. That prophet must die.'

es.L: Pero el profeta que tenga la presunción de hablar en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre una palabra que yo no le he mandado hablar, o que hable en nombre de otros dioses, ese profeta morirá”.
es.B: Pero el profeta que se atreva a decir en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre una palabra que yo no le he mandado decir, o que hable en nombre de otros dioses, ese profeta debe morir”.
es.R: Pero supongamos que un profeta se atreve a decir algo en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre que yo no le mandé decir, o que habla de parte de otros dioses. Ese profeta debe morir”.

fr.L: Mais le prophète qui aura la présomption de dire en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom une parole que je ne lui ai pas commandé de dire, ou qui parlera au nom d’autres dieux, ce prophète-là mourra.”
fr.B: Mais un prophète qui ose dire en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom une parole que je ne lui ai pas commandé de dire, ou qui parle au nom d’autres dieux, ce prophète doit mourir.”
fr.R: Mais imaginons qu’un prophète ose dire quelque chose en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom alors que je ne lui ai pas dit de le dire, ou qu’il parle de la part d’autres dieux. Ce prophète doit mourir.”

sw.L: Lakini nabii atakayethubutu kwa kiburi kusema neno kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwamuru kulisema, au atakayesema kwa jina la miungu mingine, nabii huyo atakufa.'
sw.B: Lakini nabii atakayethubutu kusema neno kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwamuru kulisema, au atakayesema kwa jina la miungu mingine, nabii huyo lazima afe.'
sw.R: Lakini tuseme nabii anathubutu kusema jambo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo sikumwambia aseme, au anasema kwa niaba ya miungu mingine. Nabii huyo lazima afe.'

vi.L: Nhưng nhà tiên tri nào xấc xược nói một lời trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho người ấy nói, hoặc nói trong danh các thần khác, thì nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'
vi.B: Còn nhà tiên tri nào dám nói nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một lời mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không truyền cho người ấy nói, hoặc nói nhân danh các thần khác, thì nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử một nhà tiên tri dám nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không bảo người ấy nói, hoặc nói thay cho các thần khác. Nhà tiên tri ấy phải chết.'

ko.L: 그러나 내가 말하라고 명령하지 않은 말을 감히 내 이름으로 말하거나, 다른 신들의 이름으로 말하는 예언자가 있으면, 그 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'
ko.B: 그러나 내가 명령하지 않은 말을 감히 내 이름으로 전하거나, 다른 신들의 이름으로 말하는 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'
ko.R: 그러나 어떤 예언자가 내가 말하라고 하지 않은 것을 감히 내 이름으로 말하거나, 다른 신들을 대신하여 말하면, 그 예언자는 죽어야 한다.'

pt.L: Mas o profeta que tiver a presunção de falar em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome uma palavra que eu não lhe ordenei falar, ou que falar em nome de outros deuses, esse profeta morrerá.'
pt.B: Mas o profeta que ousar dizer em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome uma palavra que eu não lhe mandei dizer, ou que falar em nome de outros deuses, esse profeta deverá morrer.'
pt.R: Mas pode ser que um profeta tenha a ousadia de dizer alguma coisa em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome que eu não mandei que ele dissesse, ou que fale em nome de outros deuses. Esse profeta deve morrer.'

decisions.choice: presumes: acts boldly and arrogantly, going beyond what he is allowed
decisions.reason: The verb is used of Israel going up to fight against the LORD's word (1:43) and of a man who will not obey the priest or judge (17:12-13). Here the prophet claims to speak for God when God has not sent him. The noun from the same root closes verse 22.

decisions.choice: and who speaks in the name of other gods: a second kind of false prophet
decisions.reason: Two cases are named: one who speaks in the LORD's name what the LORD has not said, and one who speaks for other gods, the case of 13:2-6.

decisions.choice: that prophet shall die: he deserves death
decisions.reason: The verb is the plain "die" and does not say who brings about the death. 13:6 commands the people to put a prophet who calls them to other gods to death; in Jeremiah 28:15-17 the LORD himself brings death on the false prophet Hananiah.

decisions.choice: the closing single quotation mark
decisions.reason: The LORD's words, opened in verse 17, end here. Moses speaks again in verse 21, where the LORD is spoken of in the third person.

records.literal_gloss: And if you say in your heart, How will we know the word which not has spoken it Yahweh?

en.L: And if you say in your heart, 'How shall we know the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken?'
en.B: You may wonder, 'How are we to recognize a word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken?'
en.R: You may ask yourself, 'How can we tell if a message did not come from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?'

es.L: Y si dices en tu corazón: “¿Cómo conoceremos la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado?”
es.B: Quizá te preguntes: “¿Cómo vamos a reconocer una palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha dicho?”
es.R: Tal vez te preguntes: “¿Cómo podemos saber si un mensaje no vino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?”

fr.L: Et si tu dis dans ton cœur : “Comment connaîtrons-nous la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ?”
fr.B: Tu te demanderas peut-être : “Comment reconnaîtrons-nous une parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ?”
fr.R: Tu te demandes peut-être : “Comment savoir si un message ne vient pas {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?”

sw.B: Huenda ukajiuliza, 'Tutalitambuaje neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema?'
sw.R: Huenda ukajiuliza, 'Tunawezaje kujua kama ujumbe haukutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?'

vi.L: Và nếu ngươi nói trong lòng: 'Làm sao chúng ta biết được lời mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không phán?'
vi.B: Có thể anh em tự hỏi: 'Làm sao chúng ta nhận biết được lời nào không phải do {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán?'
vi.R: Có thể anh em tự hỏi: 'Làm sao chúng ta biết được một sứ điệp không đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?'

ko.L: 그리고 네가 마음속으로 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀을 우리가 어떻게 알 수 있겠는가?' 하고 말한다면,
ko.B: 너희는 속으로 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀을 우리가 어떻게 알아볼 수 있을까?' 하고 물을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 여러분은 '어떤 말이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이 아닌지 우리가 어떻게 알 수 있을까?' 하고 궁금해할 수도 있습니다.

pt.L: E, se disseres no teu coração: 'Como conheceremos a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou?'
pt.B: Talvez perguntes a ti mesmo: 'Como vamos reconhecer uma palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou?'
pt.R: Podes te perguntar: 'Como vamos saber se uma mensagem não veio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?'

decisions.choice: say in your heart: ask yourself, think
decisions.reason: To "say in the heart" is to think a thing without saying it aloud (7:17; 8:17; 9:4).

decisions.choice: the word: a message claimed to be from the LORD
decisions.reason: The same noun means both "word" and "thing" or "event". Verse 22 makes use of both senses: a word from the LORD is shown to be his when the thing it speaks of comes about.

decisions.choice: you say ... we know: the singular "you" asks for all
decisions.reason: The question is put in the mouth of each Israelite (singular "you") but asks for the whole people ("we").

decisions.choice: You may wonder / ask yourself; recognize; message
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of "say in your heart". Readable says "message" for "word", since a spoken message from a prophet is meant; Balanced keeps "word".

records.literal_gloss: That which speaks the prophet in [the] name of Yahweh, and not happens the thing and not comes, it [is] the word which not has spoken it Yahweh; in presumption has spoken it the prophet; not you shall be afraid of him.

en.L: What the prophet speaks in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the thing does not happen and does not come [about], that [is] the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken; in presumption the prophet has spoken it; you shall not be afraid of him.
en.B: When a prophet speaks in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and his word does not happen or come true, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did not speak that word. The prophet spoke it presumptuously; do not be afraid of him.
en.R: If a prophet says something in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s name and it does not happen or come true, then that message did not come from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The prophet spoke without any right to do so. Do not be afraid of him.

es.L: Lo que el profeta hable en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y la cosa no suceda ni se cumpla, esa [es] la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado; con presunción la ha hablado el profeta; no tendrás temor de él.
es.B: Cuando un profeta hable en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y su palabra no suceda ni se cumpla, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no habló esa palabra. El profeta la dijo con presunción; no le tengas miedo.
es.R: Si un profeta dice algo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no sucede ni se cumple, entonces ese mensaje no vino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El profeta habló sin tener ningún derecho a hacerlo. No le tengas miedo.

fr.L: Ce que le prophète dit au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et que la chose n’arrive pas et ne se réalise pas, c’est la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dite ; c’est par présomption que le prophète l’a dite ; tu n’auras pas peur de lui.
fr.B: Quand un prophète parle au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que sa parole ne s’accomplit pas et ne se réalise pas, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas dit cette parole. Le prophète l’a dite avec présomption ; n’aie pas peur de lui.
fr.R: Si un prophète dit quelque chose au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et que cela n’arrive pas, que cela ne se réalise pas, alors ce message ne vient pas {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Le prophète a parlé sans en avoir le droit. N’aie pas peur de lui.

sw.L: Lile ambalo nabii atasema kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na jambo hilo lisitokee wala lisitimie, hilo [ndilo] neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema; kwa kiburi nabii amelisema; usimwogope.
sw.B: Nabii anaposema kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na neno lake lisitokee wala lisitimie, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakulisema neno hilo. Nabii huyo alilisema kwa kiburi; usimwogope.
sw.R: Nabii akisema jambo kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na jambo hilo lisitokee wala lisitimie, basi ujumbe huo haukutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nabii huyo alisema bila kuwa na mamlaka ya kufanya hivyo. Usimwogope.

vi.L: Điều nhà tiên tri nói trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà việc ấy không xảy ra và không đến, thì đó [là] lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không phán; nhà tiên tri đã nói điều ấy cách xấc xược; ngươi chớ sợ người ấy.
vi.B: Khi một nhà tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói, và lời ấy không xảy ra hay không thành sự thật, thì đó không phải là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Nhà tiên tri ấy đã nói cách xấc xược; đừng sợ người ấy.
vi.R: Nếu một nhà tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nói điều gì mà điều ấy không xảy ra hay không thành sự thật, thì sứ điệp ấy không đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nhà tiên tri ấy đã nói mà không có quyền gì để nói. Đừng sợ người ấy.

ko.L: 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말하였는데 그 일이 이루어지지 않고 일어나지 않으면, 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하지 않으신 말씀이다. 그 예언자가 교만하여 그것을 말한 것이니, 너는 그를 두려워하지 말라.
ko.B: 어떤 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말하였는데 그 말이 이루어지지 않고 그대로 일어나지 않으면, 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이 아니다. 그 예언자가 제멋대로 말한 것이니, 너희는 그를 두려워하지 말라.
ko.R: 어떤 예언자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 말하였는데 그 일이 일어나지 않거나 그대로 되지 않으면, 그 말은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 것이 아닙니다. 그 예언자는 아무런 권한도 없이 말한 것입니다. 그를 두려워하지 마십시오.

pt.L: Quando o profeta falar em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e a coisa não acontecer nem se cumprir, essa [é] a palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou; com presunção o profeta a falou; não terás medo dele.
pt.B: Quando um profeta falar em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a sua palavra não acontecer nem se cumprir, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não falou essa palavra. O profeta falou com presunção; não terás medo dele.
pt.R: Se um profeta disser alguma coisa em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e isso não acontecer nem se cumprir, então essa mensagem não veio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O profeta falou sem ter nenhum direito de falar. Não tenhas medo dele.

decisions.choice: the thing ... the word: the same noun, the event and the message
decisions.reason: The noun of verse 21 appears twice: "the thing" that does not happen and "the word" the LORD has not spoken. If what was spoken does not come about, the word was not the LORD's.

decisions.choice: does not happen: a failed word shows a false prophet, but a word that comes true is not enough by itself
decisions.reason: This test shows when a prophet has not been sent. 13:2-4 adds that even a sign that comes true does not make a prophet true if he calls Israel to other gods. A true prophet must speak in the LORD's name, call Israel to the LORD alone, and see his word come about.

decisions.choice: in presumption: from his own arrogance, not from the LORD
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb of verse 20. The prophet spoke boldly on his own authority.

decisions.choice: you shall not be afraid of him: do not hold him in awe or fear his threats
decisions.reason: A prophet's words could be frightening, as warnings of disaster were. Israel need not fear the words of one the LORD has not sent, nor fear to act against him.

decisions.choice: the LORD did not speak that word; spoke without any right to do so
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "the word that the LORD has not spoken" as a plain statement. Readable explains "in presumption": the prophet had no right to speak for the LORD.
